relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: renowned for founding the first Zen Buddhist monastery outside Asia (Tassajara Zen Mountain Center)

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: Suzuki founded San Francisco Zen Center

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: In 1916, 12-year-old Suzuki decided to train with a disciple of his father, Gyokujun So-on Suzuki.

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: From 1925 to 1926 Suzuki did Zen training with Dojun Kato in Shizuoka at Kenko-in.

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: In 1925 Shunryu graduated from preparatory school and entered Komazawa University, the Soto Zen university in Tokyo.

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: After graduating from Komazawa, Suzuki continued training at Eihei-ji. In September 1930, he entered the training temple.

relations.subject: Shunryu Suzuki
relations.evidence: At Eihei-ji, Suzuki was assigned to serve Ian Kishizawa-roshi, a noted Soto teacher associated with Nishiari Bokusan and Oka Sotan.
